## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Debashish Anmol Vidhyalaya Playschool?
New No 5, Old No 11, 24th Street, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Debashish Anmol Vidhyalaya Playschool have?
Day care (1.5–10 yrs, 9 am–7 pm), Play Group (2–3 yrs), Nursery (3–4 yrs), LKG (4–5 yrs), UKG (5–6 yrs), Phonics, Handwriting, Hindi classes, Karate, Classical music, Sloka & bhajan, Silambam, Yoga, Tuitions UKG–8th, Summer camp, CCTV surveillance.

### What ages do you take?
Play Group from 2 years, Nursery, LKG and UKG up to 6 years, and day care from 1.5 to 10 years.

### Is the school safe?
The campus is under CCTV surveillance, with secure facilities and a low student-to-teacher ratio.
